import os
from boltons.fileutils import rotate_file

def test_bug(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "f.txt"
    p.write_text("CRITICAL DATA")
    rotate_file(p, keep=1)
    assert p.exists()
    assert not (tmp_path / "f.1.txt").exists()

    p2 = tmp_path / "f2.txt"
    p2.write_text("current")
    for i in range(1, 6):
        (tmp_path / f"f2.{i}.txt").write_text(f"gen {i}")
    rotate_file(p2, keep=5)
    assert (tmp_path / "f2.5.txt").exists()
